subject.title: [Feature]: Remove redundant Control UI desktop top bar; add back/forward navigation to the macOS app

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's desktop topbar removal plus native macOS history controls as the product direction for this issue?
rationale: The request is a user-facing UI/product change, current main still has the old chrome/history gap, and an open focused PR already implements the direction.

options.title: Review and land the focused PR
options.body: Accept the direction through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102808 after normal review and let that merge close this issue.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Ask for separate web-topbar and macOS-history changes if maintainers want independent rollout or design review.

options.title: Reject the chrome change
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue with a product-direction note if maintainers want to keep the current desktop breadcrumb topbar.

recommendation.title: Review and land the focused PR
recommendation.body: Accept the direction through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102808 after normal review and let that merge close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the direct linked implementation PR and has the strongest recent history on the touched Control UI/macOS direction.
